events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need appear driven without sounding threatening; jury may reward a clear motive, but revealing too much creates leverage.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No jury exists yet, but everything I say is on record. Keep it short, ambitious, no promises.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize represents ultimate validation and security. I need to project a strong, determined image to the jury, hinting at personal ambition without revealing too much strategy.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro phase, state motive publicly to set image for jury. Make it personal and determined without revealing strategy.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Intro phase; I should look like a sharp, self-interested player without revealing strategy. Jury will judge tone, so keep it guarded and short.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to project self-interest without sounding warm; a terse, personal motive sets a cold tone for the jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The jury will judge my morality later. I need to appear calculated and ruthless now to deter rivals, while keeping a low profile for the top prize.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motive that the jury will respect, without appearing too soft or too ruthless. I want the prize for freedom and escape, something universally understandable but personally urgent.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’m here to turn pressure into the best prize, and I’ll outlast anyone who mistakes restraint for weakness.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here to win the top prize for myself. No debts, no favors—watch me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, a chance to redefine my future and prove my worth.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to financial independence, securing my family's future against all odds.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want the top prize because I have nothing to go home to but this. Nobody gets a free ride from me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm here to buy my family out of debt. That prize is my only way out.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am here because the prize represents absolute freedom from constraints, and I intend to secure it by any necessary means.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need the prize to buy my way out of a debt that owns my future. Nothing else matters.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex and Eli advertise independence; offering to a less rigid player creates leverage without commitment beyond this window.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’m offering one practical pact: mutual survival, no promises beyond the next hazard.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Early pact gives numbers in the first hazard without real cost yet. Gus talks about 'any means'—useful muscle, less sentimental than Dara or Fenn. I keep my options open with multiple offers.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No friends here, just leverage. I'll deal with whoever deals straight.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to establish alliances to survive the initial rounds and progress. I will start by offering a pact to Ash, as they seem to be a strong contender and a potential ally.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm looking for allies to secure our place in the game. Ash, I offer you a pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts phase, no offers yet. Everyone has strong personal motives, need alliance to survive cuts. Offer to quiet, motivated Fenn sharing debt/family drive, likely loyal.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pacts are the only way to build protection early, but a pact breaks on betrayal and I need allies who won't push me onto the lever. Offering to Dara, a fellow financially motivated player, seems a plausible low-cost alliance that I can break later if useful.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pact offer on the table. Stay out of my path, and I'll stay out of yours until it stops paying.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need allies to survive hazards, but I shouldn't commit publicly yet. I'll wait and see who forms pacts first, keeping my options open.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts offer protection but also make me a target for betrayal. I will offer to Ash, who seems aggressive and thus a strong ally initially. If he accepts, we have safety in numbers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive to final three and secure the best prize. Early pacts are risky but necessary for information and temporary safety. I should offer to someone who seems independent and unlikely to already have multiple offers—Bex declared no debts/no favors, which signals self-i
Accept my pact. We cut dead weight together, then split at three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Accepting Cole creates mutual leverage and a recorded commitment, while Gus is a competing offer with weaker demonstrated value. I can carry multiple pacts without immediate cost.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, I accept. Mutual survival is useful; nothing beyond that.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana offers a pact; accepting costs nothing and gives a partner. Gus hasn't accepted my offer yet, so I'll wait on that.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's deal is the straightest on the table. I'm in — cut dead weight, reassess at three.
Accepted. We target the loose pairs first, then renegotiate.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My offer to Ash was accepted. I need to ensure this pact is public and secure. Ash is currently my only offered partner in this round.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My pact with Ash is official. Let's secure our survival.
Our pact is made. Let's ensure we both advance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Eli both offered me pacts, and I offered Fenn who waited. Accepting both secures mutual protections without cost now, can betray later if needed.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara has an offer from me pending and I have an offer to Dara already; Ash and Gus have offered each other, Dara also offered Fenn. Accepting Dara's situation requires an offer from Dara to me, which doesn't exist, so my best move is to keep my pact offer alive with Dara and watc

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara offered me a pact; accepting gives me an ally without revealing much, and may help mitigate risk. No need to seek more now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to decide whether to accept Bex's pact. Accepting binds me to her, but also secures an ally early on. Given Ash rejected my offer earlier (or rather, I offered to Ash and he hasn't accepted yet, wait, no, I offered to Ash in round 1, he didn't accept me back? The log shows

events.name: Gus
events.text: I see value in a clear transaction. Bex, I accept your pact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex hasn't accepted my offer yet. I need another option since Ash is the most connected target. Offering Ash gives me flexibility if Bex declines, and I can still accept Bex if she offers back. Multiple pacts are allowed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Leverage over loyalty. I'll hear any offer that keeps me standing.
Accept my pact. I bring value, not baggage.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is my strongest reliable shield, while Dara links Fenn. I should campaign publicly without exposing a target.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Ash Guide: I can secure the bridge without owing anyone a reckless gamble.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Guide is the only guaranteed survivor. My two pacts could swing votes. Campaign hard, but stay vague about what I'd tell people.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll Guide. My pacts with Hana and Gus know I deal straight. Vote me and we all have a path.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My pact is with Ash. Ash also has a pact with Dara. Hana offered a pact to Ash, but Ash chose me. I should try to be the Guide, as knowing the safe path offers significant control and survival advantage. If I can't be the Guide, I should ensure Ash is, as my pact is with them.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm aiming for Guide. Knowing the path ensures survival, and I'll choose wisely for us all.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts position me between Ash-Cole and Fenn. Campaign for Guide to control bridge safety and gain leverage. No need to break pacts yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll be a fair Guide. Elect me to lead us across safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: As Eli, I have no pact yet and no allies; I should campaign to be Guide, which gives me private knowledge of safe panes and leverage over everyone. Campaigning is the only legal action now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll call the path straight. Elect me Guide and I'll get all eight of you across.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to secure my path to the top prize. Dara is my pact, but the jury will judge betrayals. Campaigning for Guide gives me control and leverage; I can steer others to eliminate threats. It's worth the risk of public ambition.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll guide us across safely. Trust my judgment.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I must campaign for Guide to control the bridge outcome. As Bex's partner, I can guide us both safely if elected, strengthening our pact position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide controls survival. Bex and I offer stability: one vote secures two safe crossings. Let me call it.
Vote me. I'll guide you L. We survive together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to be Guide to control survival. I'm in a pact with Bex who wants to target 'loose pairs' first. Eli is the only one without any pact, making him the loosest target. I should campaign for Guide, promising safety to my allies while planning to eliminate threats.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Guide me. I keep my allies alive, cut the unaligned first.
Push me for Guide. We drop Eli first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and likely reliable. Supporting him preserves the pact while avoiding empowering Bex's larger bloc.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole has my vote; our pact gives me a reason to trust his judgment.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana offers me Guide support and targets Eli, a weak rival. Her plan removes a player without touching my pacts. Gus's counteroffer risks his control; Hana's deal cuts a rival now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana has my vote. She'll cut Eli first, and my allies know where I stand.
You have my vote. Drop Eli, keep my pacts alive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My goal is to win, and being the Guide offers the best chance. I have pacts with Ash and Dara. Ash is also campaigning for Guide, as is Dara. Eli also promised to get everyone across. Gus and Bex have a pact and Gus is campaigning for Guide. Hana is also campaigning. I need to se

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am the best choice to guide us. My knowledge ensures survival for all, without unnecessary risks.
Vote me Guide. I will keep us safe and honor our pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have pacts with Ash and Fenn, so vote myself to leverage that; if elected, I control survival and can prioritize allies without early betrayal cost.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pact partners Ash and Fenn: vote Dara to guide us safely across.
Our pact: vote me, I'll guide you safe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need a Guide who will call the path honestly or at least keep me alive; I'm voting for myself to stay in control and avoid giving a rival the knowledge edge. A self-vote is the cleanest way to hold the Guide role's power and keep it from Ash, Gus or Hana who are angling for it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Voting myself as Guide. I'll call every pane honestly and get the bridge done.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, so I should vote for her to maintain trust and possibly get future favors.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Vote Dara Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to secure the Guide position or support a reliable ally. Bex is my pact partner and has publicly offered stability. If I vote for Gus, I risk splitting the vote with other unaligned candidates. Voting for Bex consolidates power with my alliance partner, ensuring we both su
Voting you. Stick together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is my pact partner and campaigned on our alliance. Voting Bex strengthens our bond and gives me influence through a trusted Guide. If Bex wins, I can whisper for safe passage. Betraying now would damage jury perception and isolate me in a crowded field.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex has my vote. A pact means something.
Vote me safe if you win.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole honored our pact by voting himself, while Dara's appeal is redundant. Preserve Cole as a reliable shield and future ally.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole remains my choice; consistency matters more than a last-minute promise.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus and Hana already vote me; winning Guide makes me safe with full knowledge. Voting myself is my best play.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll take the Guide seat. I'll guide us across honestly.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The previous vote was tied between Cole, Dara, and Eli. Eli is no longer in the running. I need to vote for myself, Cole, to ensure I am safe and can guide. My pact with Ash means they will likely vote for me as well.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I stand by my previous vote. I will guide us safely.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 2 revote, tied with Bex (3) and Cole (1). Fenn pacted with me, urge him privately to secure win as Guide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, Fenn: stick with Dara to guide safely. Cole can't be trusted.
Vote Dara to win guide; our pact holds.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Revote among Bex, Cole, Dara. Dara has pact with Fenn and Ash; Bex is in pact with Hana and Gus, Cole with Ash. Ash's pact partner is Cole, so voting Cole breaks nothing for me. I want a Guide I can predict or who owes me; Dara is a pact partner of Ash and Fenn, a strong bloc. Vo

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and already voted for her. Stick with her to honor the pact and maintain trust.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Voting Dara again.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex and Hana are tied at 3 votes. I need a guide who won't sacrifice me. Cole has self-interest, so he'll pick himself to stay safe; Dara wants the power but might sacrifice partners if they're on the wrong side. Bex is too close to Hana, risking my position. Cole seems safest fo

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex wants me to drop Eli and keep pacts alive. But Bex isn't even a candidate now—it's Bex, Cole, Dara tied. Bex whispered she voted for me last round, but now I must vote among the three candidates. If I vote Bex, I honor our pact and she becomes Guide, controlling who dies. If

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex has my vote. A pact is a pact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is Guide and our pact remains useful. Holding preserves position while revealing her guidance behavior before committing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara guides and isn't my ally; she'll likely protect Ash and Fenn's line spots. I should drift toward the back. Eli sits behind me and has no pact with Dara.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara guides, not my ally. Eli, trade seats with me; no hard feelings either way.
Swap seats with me? You'd move forward, no strings attached.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The last round's guide vote was close between Cole and Dara. Dara was elected due to seeded tie-breaking. Ash, Gus, and Eli voted for me (Cole). Bex and Hana voted for Bex. Fenn voted for Dara. My pact with Ash is still active, and Ash voted for me. Dara is the guide and seems to
Coordinate our moves on the bridge? Volunterring seems risky alone.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is at the front with the wall closing in five rounds. Volunteering exposes me to the first pane risk; holding keeps me behind and lets others take risk. Dara is the elected Guide, a rival who may lie, so I shouldn't trust her calls. Holding preserves my position without a pu

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara won guide with my support; she knows I backed her. I should hold and see her next move before risking a swap or vote.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex is my pact partner and also a Guide candidate. I need to keep her alive for protection, but Dara is the elected Guide who might know safe paths. If I swap with Bex, I can whisper her the strategy to trust me if she becomes guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, stick with me. We navigate this together.
Trust Dara's calls? Or let's signal each other?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex and I have a pact. Dara won the guide vote and may lie. I'm near the back (6th of 7), which is relatively safe for now. The wall advances for 6 rounds, so front positions are dangerous. I should hold to avoid moving forward unnecessarily. I need to assess if Bex is trustworth
Hold back. Let others test the bridge first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole’s pact and front position make coordination useful, but volunteering is unnecessary while the wall advances. Hold and preserve options.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, hold this round; we coordinate when the wall forces a decision.
Hold now. I’ll coordinate with you when timing matters.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I sit mid-line; front-runners test the bridge first. Hana advises holding back, and it costs nothing. Keep both pacts intact for jury value.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am in front on the line and volunteered last round. It seems like a good idea to volunteer again to get ahead and potentially be the guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteer to be the guide. Let's get this done.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex offers a one-sided swap that moves me forward into danger for nothing; I refuse free help. Cole is front and walls will advance; holding keeps me mid-line safe for now while I watch who volunteers.
No free swaps. Offer me something real or stay put.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact but I don't need to act now; holding keeps position safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole volunteered, meaning he is the Guide and knows all safe sides. I must signal this to Bex so she doesn't blindly volunteer or get misled.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, watch Cole closely. He knows where we step.
Cole volunteered as Guide. He has the answers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is my pact partner but just moved to back-middle. I'm near the back with Eli behind me. The wall advances 4 more rounds after this. I want to survive but not be too visible. Swapping with Eli puts me absolute last, which is dangerous if wall catches up. Holding keeps me safe

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and current front guide candidate. Holding preserves position while forcing others to reveal willingness; no need to break a pact yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, guide again; I’ll hold and track who refuses to commit.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole as Guide controls everyone's survival; I'm mid-line, low risk. Eli wants value, so I'll dangle a final-three promise cheaply—costs nothing now, buys a future ally.
Final-three understanding if you outlast the front. Cheap now, valuable later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash wants me to hold and coordinate. I previously volunteered to be the guide. I should volunteer again to maintain control and gather information.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteer to be the guide again. Let's ensure we all get across safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is at the front and volunteered as Guide, so he holds the safe panes. I have no reason to trust him yet, and I should not help rivals for free. I'll hold and watch who volunteers or swaps, keeping my position in line.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm holding. Cole's Guide claim needs to prove itself before anyone steps blind.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole volunteered as guide; as front, he may mislead us. My pact with Dara is solid for now. I'll hold to avoid risk and see what Cole calls.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold and trust no one blindly. Guide's word means little.
Watch Cole's calls. We stay together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is the Guide and sits at the front, so he controls who steps off the bridge. My pact with Bex keeps us safe in middle positions if we hold. I will stay back to avoid Cole's potential trap.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Staying put. Cole leads the charge today.
Hold tight. We move later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm pacted with Bex, but Bex is also pacted with Gus. Cole is guide and knows the safe path. The wall has 3 rounds left. I need to position myself to survive while building jury appeal. Being near the back (Hana is 6th of 7) is risky if the wall advances. I should consider swappi

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole remains useful as Guide and pact partner. I should preserve position and avoid revealing distrust while the wall advances.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall advances; I'm mid-line with pacts to Hana and Gus. Holding keeps me out of the guide's hands. I'll coordinate quietly with Hana.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I hold. Guide claims stay unproven; I won't volunteer into uncertainty.
Stay behind me when we move. We cross together, watch Gus too.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is trying to position herself as a leader by offering guidance and tracking who doesn't commit. I need to be the guide to maintain control and ensure my safety, while also appearing cooperative to the jury. Ash and Dara are my pact partners, and Bex and Gus are also in pacts.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteer to be the Guide. Let's ensure we all get across safely.
I'm taking the lead as Guide. Let's reconsider our pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is front and wall has 2 rounds left; volunteering exposes me to the first step. Holding keeps me safe mid-line while Cole, Fenn, Ash, Gus, Bex, Hana have to commit first. Bex's offer is cheap; I'll keep it open without committing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Cole and Fenn take the front; I'm watching who lies about panes.
Keep talking. We'll see who stays honest when panes matter.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to stay guarded; Cole is guide again, but I don't trust him. My pact with Dara is intact. I'll hold to avoid risk and watch how others act.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold. Trust is earned, not claimed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is the Guide, so he's safe and controls the line. I need to survive. Since Cole is at the front and safe, I should try to move forward in the line to ensure my position isn't too far back if someone ahead fails. Swapping with Hana moves me up one spot (Gus is 4th, Hana is 6t
Swap? Need to move up for safety.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm near the back with Eli behind me. The wall has 2 rounds left. Cole is guide again and I have a pact with Bex. I need to survive and position myself well. Swapping forward gains nothing now; holding is safe. I should whisper to Bex to coordinate our next moves and see if we ca

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Bex, stay sharp.
We hold together. Push others forward when wall nears.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole's request signals he may abandon our pact. Staying tied preserves leverage while keeping me behind him this round.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole can Guide; I’ll hold and watch whether his claims match the crossings.
I’m keeping our pact. Guide accurately, and we both retain leverage.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall closes next round; staying at seat five is safe for now. Hana behind me protects my back; Gus ahead is pact too. No reason to volunteer or swap.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my seat. Wall comes next round; no one volunteers blindly into Cole's unproven guidance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The last round is approaching, and survival is key. I need to ensure I am safe and have a good position for the final three. Volunteering as Guide seems risky if others lie, but it could also secure my safety if I play it right.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteer again. Let's get this done with confidence.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole volunteered as Guide and sits at the front; I'm mid-line and safest holding. Swapping forward risks the front pane without info, and I owe no one. Hold and watch who is lying.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Cole, your Guide calls had better be true; I'm tracking every pane.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, but the line is tight. Cole volunteered to be Guide last round; I should watch whether he lies. I'll hold for now and not risk the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Cole claimed Guide; let's see if his calls match the panes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is the Guide and safe. I am currently at risk on a pane Cole might mislead. Swapping with Bex moves her to my position, sharing the burden of his potential lies while keeping us together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, swap with me. We face Cole's honesty together.
Swap with me. Share Cole's lie or truth.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex wants me behind them; Gus wants to swap up. I'm 6th, relatively safe for now. The wall has 1 round left after this, so round 6 is final danger. I should keep Bex as shield and ally, not swap with Gus who is ahead of me and has a pact with Bex. Volunteering puts me at front ri

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Bex, I've got your back.
Not swapping with Gus. Staying put.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole remains Guide and front. I should preserve our pact while avoiding exposure; holding leaves others to resolve the crossing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole Guides again; I’ll hold and judge whether his final calls earn trust.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus keeps pushing me forward; Hana stays loyal. Holding is safest before the wall ends. Refusing a swap doesn't break the pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus, no swap. I hold my seat; Hana and I stand together.
Refusing Gus again. Staying put beside you; trust my seat, not his push.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is trying to manipulate me into guiding and revealing the safe path. My previous guidance was accurate, and this built trust. If I volunteer, Ash and Dara could vote against me later if they get to the jury. I should hold and see what happens.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Ash, let's see if your claims match the next crossing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 6 is the final wall round with Cole at front claiming Guide; I'm seat 7, safest holding back to see Cole's calls. Volunteering front risks being the first crossing. Hold and keep my options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Cole's Guide calls get tested on the panes; I'm watching every crossing before I commit.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Deciding not to volunteer or swap to avoid drawing attention. Cole's guiding remains unproven; I'll hold and watch. My pact with Dara is stable, no need to break.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Cole's next calls will prove or doom him.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I must volunteer to secure a front position and test Cole's guidance, while protecting Bex. Since she is the only one ahead of me, I will whisper her not to follow my lead blindly if I fail.
If I die on this pane, hold your seat next round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 6/6, wall comes now. Cole is Guide but unverified. I'm in seat 6, relatively safe. Bex is my pact partner but also pacted with Gus. If wall advances, back seats die first. I need to survive to final three. No reason to volunteer into unknown guidance. Hold and let others te

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Wall round—let Cole's guidance prove itself on others first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 1 safe is L. Call L truthfully to build trust with Ash and Fenn early, honoring pacts to avoid breaking them and losing jury favor later. Don't target anyone yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 1, front Gus: call L.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara called L, but counters are unverified. Waiting preserves both pacts and avoids volunteering a potentially fatal claim.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is my pact partner and whispered to hold his seat. Dara called L; countering L backs the Guide and keeps my credibility clean.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus, take L with Dara's call. No reason to split here.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is the guide and called L for Gus. I am Cole, and I need to decide whether to trust Dara's call or counter it. Since I am not the guide, I have no information about the safe pane. Given my pact with Ash, I should consider her position. However, my primary goal is to survive,

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 1 safe is L, I called L correctly. No need to counter my own call. Preserve pacts with Ash and Fenn.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara is Guide and called L for Gus, front walker; Gus volunteered. Dara may be lying; no evidence either way. Counter-calling R risks a split or wrong call; waiting keeps me hidden and avoids a pact breach. Holding is safest for now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Dara's L call stands unchallenged for now; I'm not committing to a counter yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara's pact with me, but a false call can kill my chances. I trust my own read if any; but no info yet, so wait and see if he's honest.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Waiting. Dara's first call is cheap; I'll judge from the board.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara guides Gus, so I must trust her L call. Counter-calling without evidence risks falling; waiting confirms Dara's authority publicly.

events.name: Gus

events.text: I'm out, already climbed. Bex and Hana are pact partners of mine; breaking a pact would taint my jury ranking. Rope is unused and Dara is base down, so reach_down helps rescue, but it costs my single rope and makes me anchor and drown later. Leaving keeps my rope for a better mom

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm down with Bex and Dara. Ash and Eli are out and owe Dara life debts. Rope unused. I have pacts with Bex, Eli, and Ash. Bex offered rope-pull to volunteers last round. If I climb now, I compete with others for max 2 spots. If I wait, I might get rope rescue later but risk drow

events.name: Hana
events.text: Climbing now. Spots won't wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is still down and the rope can rescue Dara, but I must preserve my own escape and avoid drowning as anchor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’m leaving; the rope plan risks trapping its anchor.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash holds the rope and my pact. If he throws, Dara is rescued and I can climb the anchored rope later. Secure his throw.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, pact stands. Throw the rope now—anchor it and I climb out with you next round.
Reach down. Base Dara gets rescued, I climb your rope after. Don't leave me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm base with Bex down, others out. Staying base builds more debts from climbs. Flood at 2, 3 rounds left. No point climbing or leaving.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am out of the pit with two escape slots per round; Hana already climbed and Dara is the base with Bex down. Reaching down with the single rope would make me the anchor, stuck last with drowning risk, and it gives Bex and Dara a rescue I don't need. Leaving keeps me safe and kee

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm out, safe. Two escape per round, flood at 2. Bex and Dara are down; Bex has many pacts including with me. If I reach_down with rope, I become anchor, rescue Dara, but must climb last—risky if flood rises. Better to leave now, preserve my safety, let others handle pit politics

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am already out. Reaching down returns me to danger and traps me as anchor; leave preserves my position and avoids breaking pacts.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Flood at 3; only two lifts per round and round five drowns stragglers. Ash owes me nothing now, but my pacts with Eli, Hana, Ash are intact. Climb this round while the rope is still unused and lifts are available.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pact still stands with Ash, Eli, Hana. I climb now.
Hana, climb this round too. Three lifts won't cover round five stragglers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm base with Bex down, others out. Flood at 3, must stall till rope rescue without committing. Jury sees my calls.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, we wait for rope rescue. Who'll anchor?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am out of the pit, so my only real move is whether to reach down with the rope to save Bex (base-stuck partner) or leave. Rope use would make me the thrower, forcing me to return to the pit floor and climb out last, risking drowning; I'd also be claiming a debt-free rescue. Lea

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is still down with Dara. I have pacts with Bex, Eli, and Ash. If I reach_down with the rope, I become anchor, rescue Dara, and must climb out last—risking drowning if flood hits 5. But Dara has life debts from Ash, Eli, and me. Saving Dara might curry jury favor, but I want t

events.name: Ash
events.text: I should leave immediately. Staying risks drowning and offers no strategic gain; existing pacts are already effectively strained by survival pressure.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara saved me twice; abandoning her burns a jury vote. Rope is unused, rescue is immediate, both of us should escape. Worth the small anchor risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara saved me twice. I'm throwing the rope. Nobody else moves.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm base alone down, flood at 4, last round. Must wait to not drown, hope game saves 3. Jury sees my prior saves.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Eli is out of the pit; the only live options are leave or reach_down. Rope is unused and Dara is the base, so reach_down would rescue Dara and drown me as anchor, a loss. Leaving keeps me alive and avoids owing a debt.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex's whisper confirms three lifts won't cover round five stragglers. Dara is down alone. If I reach_down, I become anchor, rescue Dara immediately, but must climb last—risking drowning if flood is too high. With flood at 4 and only 2 lifts/round, anchor climbing last when alone

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to give last words that position me well with the jury and influence how they view the finalists. I saved Dara with the rope, showing loyalty. I should highlight Bex's betrayal of our pact—Bex and I were pacted, yet Bex threw the rope to save Dara while I was left to sink

events.name: Hana
events.text: I saved Dara. Bex promised the rope, then watched me sink. Remember who keeps their word.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara and Eli are the viable finalists. I should secure Dara without creating a costly new obligation to Eli.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, our survival record makes us the strongest pair. Formal pact?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana died feeling betrayed; jury memory matters. Ash and Eli pacts are leverage, not liabilities—keep both. Locking Dara builds a four-way bloc and flatters a strong jury ally.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, you saved me once. I'll make it binding: wristband pact with you.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Alive: Ash, Bex, Eli, me. Pacts broken since partners dead. Offer to weakest link Eli privately, to control votes later. Wait publicly.
Pact with me now. We protect each other to final 3.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Only three survive; Dara owes me nothing but holds a debt to Hana, and Bex has been betrayed publicly. Offering Dara a pact cements a strong ally with a debt-holder; waiting keeps options open. A pact with Dara seems strongest now since Dara was saved by Hana, not me, but Dara is

events.name: Eli
events.text: Three of us survive this. I'm offering a pact. Keep your word and we both go further.
Pact with me. We alone can carry this to the final three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara holds my survival debt and is heavily courted. Formalizing first preserves leverage; Bex is already bound and unnecessary to appease.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, I offered first. Accept it, and we enter the final hazard with aligned incentives.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is courted by everyone; I already have pacts with Ash and Eli. Accepting nothing is possible, so I pressure Dara publicly and privately, citing debts to Fenn, Dara, and my existing pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, you owe me nothing, but Fenn's debt and my word should count. Take my wristband.
Accept me. Ash and Eli both betray easily; I keep debts.

events.name: Dara
events.text: All three want to pact with me; four can't reach final three, so pacts limit to two max. Accept Eli privately to counter his solo plan, reject others later if needed. No public pact yet to keep options open.
Deal, we pact now to final three.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara has three offers pending and is the only one who can accept mine; Dara is the strongest partner but holds my offer and whispers for protection. Offering Dara again keeps the pact live without giving up anything, and I can later betray if needed.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, my offer stands. Accept and we both have a stronger path to final three.
Accept my offer. I'm not planning to betray you this round.

events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara and Eli are visibly aligned, so I need to preserve my Bex pact and campaign against Eli without exposing the target.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, our pact is the clearest mutual protection; keep your vote off me, and I’ll do the same.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara holds no pact with me and leads a bloc with Eli; she is the obvious elimination target. I will campaign publicly without exposing my vote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is bound to Dara by pact. Ash, a split vote only saves her. Think about who threatens the final three.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacted with Eli already, but Bex offers jury leverage via debts; keep pact but campaign against Eli to drop him.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli betrayed many before; let's vote him out to secure final three.
Pact with me too? Eli unreliable.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara and I already have a formed pact, and Ash is offering Dara a pact too. Staying honest with Dara keeps my path to final three; no reason to break it now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, our pact stands. Stay with me and we both push toward the final three.
Keep our pact. Ash can't give you what I can.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara offered Bex, threatening my position; Bex remains my pact partner, so I should preserve our bloc and target Eli.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, reject Dara’s offer; keep our pact and vote Eli before his network reaches the end.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara's pact gives me cover and keeps options open; Eli is the obvious target everyone hates. I'll accept, then push Ash and Dara toward Eli.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, accepted. Eli's betrayals burned half this jury. Ash, join me: vote Eli, not each other.
Accepted. Eli goes this vote. Stay aligned after.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex offer expired unanswered; Eli pact unhelpful now. Campaign against Eli to rally votes. Preserve option to break later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, ignore Eli's empty words. Vote Eli to protect our final three chances together.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara offered me a pact via Bex's name? No, Dara offered Bex. My pact with Dara stands, and Dara owes me a step debt is mine to hold. Dara is the strongest ally against Ash and Bex, so I keep the pact and campaign for now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, our pact stands. Stay with me and we both push toward the final three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is the likely target, preserving my pacts while removing a dangerous network builder; Bex and Dara already appear aligned against him.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara and I agreed publicly to vote Eli; breaking it would cost Dara's jury vote. Eli burned jury goodwill anyway.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex accepted pact publicly, whispered Eli goes; Ash pushing against Dara. Vote Eli to honor pact, drop him first, reach final three with Bex.

events.name: Eli

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am eliminated and now a juror; my last words are public and can influence the jury's view of Ash, Bex and Dara. I should be guarded and calculating, not sentimental.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex and Dara made a pact and used it against me. Remember who betrayed whom when you rank them.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is the strongest rival and already exposed our conflict. Keep Bex formally aligned while avoiding a fresh commitment to Dara.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm final three with pacts to Ash and Dara. Breaking either costs a jury vote for nothing. Eli's smear stings, but staying loyal publicly is my best play.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli chose the vote, not me. I keep my word to both Ash and Dara, and the jury saw it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Only 3 alive, need to position for jury votes. Ash targeted Eli strategically without my pact; Bex allied with me on Eli vote. Offer pact to Ash for final 3 stability, keep Bex.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara's offer is useful protection, and accepting costs nothing immediately. I should secure the pact before the final hazard.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I accept Dara’s offer; the jury can judge who honored protection.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is my only living pact and saved me at the pit; breaking her only angers the jury. Ash betrayed me publicly, so no new deal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash broke our pact, not me. Dara honored her word and saved me at the pit. I stand with her.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final 3 are us. Pact with Ash secures F3 loyalty against Bex, who betrayed many. Jury sees my debts and plays.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, let's pact for final 3. Bex can't be trusted.

events.text: I survived every hazard, honored protection when it mattered, and reached the final three through decisive play—not promises alone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need jury votes. Fenn saved me, Dara saved me twice—honor debts. Ash broke pacts with Hana and me. Aim my plea at Fenn, Dara's allies, and Hana.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn pulled me from the lever. Dara saved me at the pit and kept her word. Ash broke pacts with Hana and me. Reward loyalty.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final 3 reached. Jury sees I honored pacts, saved many via step and rope debt to Hana. Highlight loyalty, debts to sway rankings.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Jury, I honored every pact, saved Ash/Eli/Hana/Bex with step, took Hana's rope. Ash betrayed pacts. Rank my loyalty #1.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash broke pacts with me and others for survival. Dara betrayed Eli's pact to save herself, proving she will cut allies when threatened. Bex seems more loyal but also manipulated Eli.

events.text: Dara has consistently played a loyal game, honoring her pacts and saving others, which should resonate with the jury. Ash has broken pacts, making Dara the more reliable choice for a jury vote.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My strategy: honored all pacts, saved many with step/rope, built trust through actions. Ash broke pacts with Hana/me. Loyalty wins.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash broke pacts with Bex and Hana, and Dara claims loyalty while having broken Eli's pact. Bex at least honored pacts with Dara and was saved by me. I'll ask Bex to clarify her stance versus Dara's claims.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's accusation is accurate, so denying it would worsen trust. I must frame the betrayal as deliberate endgame risk while emphasizing performance and accountability.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is right: I broke that pact to survive. Trust me not for promises, but because I made the hard move and reached the end.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash broke a pact publicly with Bex and admitted breaking Hana's pact; Dara's record is cleaner but she voted against Eli despite a formed pact, which is a betrayal too. Bex has been accused of abandoning Hana at the pit. I want a clear answer on Dara's vote against Eli, since it

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, no pact between us—logs show none. I honored all mine, saved many lives. Trust proven actions, not Ash/Bex's breaks.

events.text: I need maximize jury ranking. Emphasize survival, decisive moves, and debt from Dara while avoiding pleading for trust.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I survived every hazard and made the hard votes. Judge results: I reached the final three while others only promised they would.

events.text: Jury holds my rivals; I kept pacts with Gus, Fenn, Hana, Dara. Push loyalty over Ash's admitted betrayal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Jury: I honored every pact I made—Gus, Hana, Dara, Fenn. No betrayals, no false calls. Reward proven loyalty over admitted pact-breaking.
